cards.title: Moon Muffin Index Card Glow Clue
cards.showSkill: replace a feeling word with one visible clue
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable index card for turning one plain moon-muffin sentence into a visible clue scene: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: Place the card beside blank paper and read the plain line before the writer adds clues: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: Show the market helper's feeling with things a reader can see on the pretend counter: ____________________.
cards.plainLinePrompt: Plain line: The moon muffin helper felt proud of the new tray: ____________________.
cards.visibleCluePrompt: Visible clue: Add one glow mark, neat stack, or careful label that shows the proud feeling: ____________________.
cards.objectActionPrompt: Object action: Let the tray, muffin wrapper, or crumb card tilt, shine, slide, or stand in a clear way: ____________________.
cards.placeSignalPrompt: Place signal: Add one pretend market sign, counter mat, or moon tag near the tray: ____________________.
cards.characterGesturePrompt: Character gesture: Show the helper straightening, pointing, nodding, or holding the tray with care: ____________________.
cards.soundOrTexturePrompt: Sound or texture: Add one paper-safe rustle, soft tap, smooth wrapper, or crumbly edge detail: ____________________.
cards.sentenceFramePrompt: Sentence frame: Instead of saying proud, write what the helper does beside the glowing tray: ____________________.
cards.reviseShowPrompt: Revise show: Change the plain line so the reader can infer the feeling from one clue and one action: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw the tray clue first, then write one shown sentence under it: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Extra paper line: Make another moon-muffin feeling visible with one object clue: ____________________.

cards.title: Puddle Planet Index Card Ripple Wait
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable index card for changing a plain puddle-mail sentence into a shown waiting moment: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: Read the plain line and invite the writer to add pretend mail clues instead of naming the feeling: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: Show that the puddle mail helper is waiting by moving the note, stamp, or puddle mark: ____________________.
cards.plainLinePrompt: Plain line: The puddle mail helper was impatient for the next note: ____________________.
cards.visibleCluePrompt: Visible clue: Add one repeated glance at a ripple mark, curled note edge, or empty paper bin: ____________________.
cards.objectActionPrompt: Object action: Make the pretend note drip, wobble, fold, tap, or float beside the helper: ____________________.
cards.placeSignalPrompt: Place signal: Add one puddle-mail counter, shell slot, or round sorting mat that shows where the waiting happens: ____________________.
cards.characterGesturePrompt: Character gesture: Show the helper tapping two fingers, leaning forward, or lining up stamps again: ____________________.
cards.soundOrTexturePrompt: Sound or texture: Add one plip, paper flutter, slick edge, or soft stamp press detail: ____________________.
cards.sentenceFramePrompt: Sentence frame: Instead of saying impatient, write what the helper keeps doing with the note: ____________________.
cards.reviseShowPrompt: Revise show: Turn the plain line into a clue sentence with one moving object and one helper gesture: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Sketch three small ripple marks, then choose one for the sentence: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Extra paper line: Show another puddle-mail wait without naming the feeling: ____________________.

cards.title: Buttonwood Index Card Ticket Pause
cards.showSkill: show uncertainty through a pause and prop
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable index card for turning a plain library-train sentence into a visible pause: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: Place the card beside blank paper and ask the writer to show uncertainty with a ticket clue: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: Make the traveler seem unsure by showing what happens to the ticket and shelf tag: ____________________.
cards.plainLinePrompt: Plain line: The traveler was unsure which library train stop to choose: ____________________.
cards.visibleCluePrompt: Visible clue: Add one crossed-out shelf tag, bent ticket corner, or paused bookmark strip: ____________________.
cards.objectActionPrompt: Object action: Let the ticket twist, hover, slide halfway, or rest between two pretend stop cards: ____________________.
cards.placeSignalPrompt: Place signal: Add one broad train bench, rolling shelf, or station card that frames the choice: ____________________.
cards.characterGesturePrompt: Character gesture: Show the traveler turning the ticket over, squinting at a tag, or holding still: ____________________.
cards.soundOrTexturePrompt: Sound or texture: Add one page whisper, wooden click, smooth ticket edge, or paper rasp detail: ____________________.
cards.sentenceFramePrompt: Sentence frame: Instead of saying unsure, write how the traveler handles the ticket between two choices: ____________________.
cards.reviseShowPrompt: Revise show: Replace the plain feeling word with one visible ticket clue and one pause action: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw the ticket between two shelf tags before writing the shown sentence: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Extra paper line: Show another library-train choice with a prop and a pause: ____________________.

cards.title: Button Bakery Index Card Map Mix
cards.showSkill: show confusion with mismatched place clues
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable index card for changing a plain bakery-map sentence into concrete show-not-tell clues: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: Read the plain line and invite the writer to show the mix-up with marks on a pretend map: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: Show that the map-mender is confused by using mismatched marks, folds, and gestures: ____________________.
cards.plainLinePrompt: Plain line: The map-mender was confused by the bakery map: ____________________.
cards.visibleCluePrompt: Visible clue: Add one button mark beside the wrong crumb dot, folded corner, or upside-down label: ____________________.
cards.objectActionPrompt: Object action: Make the map crinkle, flip, buckle, or slide away from the correct paper tag: ____________________.
cards.placeSignalPrompt: Place signal: Add one pretend bakery counter, map table, or tray label that helps the reader see the mix-up: ____________________.
cards.characterGesturePrompt: Character gesture: Show the map-mender tilting the page, tracing a loop, or stopping with one finger on a mark: ____________________.
cards.soundOrTexturePrompt: Sound or texture: Add one paper crinkle, dry fold line, soft button tap, or dusty crumb edge detail: ____________________.
cards.sentenceFramePrompt: Sentence frame: Instead of saying confused, write what does not match on the map and how the mender reacts: ____________________.
cards.reviseShowPrompt: Revise show: Change the plain line into a sentence with one mismatched clue and one clear action: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Circle two map marks first, then write which one looks out of place: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Extra paper line: Show another map mix-up with one place clue and one object action: ____________________.

cards.title: Teacup Town Index Card Weather Peek
cards.showSkill: show curiosity through looking and texture
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable index card for turning one plain Teacup Town sentence into a shown weather-window moment: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: Place the card beside blank paper and ask for one pretend weather-window clue the writer can show: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: Show the watcher's curiosity through looking, touching the paper pane, and noticing texture: ____________________.
cards.plainLinePrompt: Plain line: The weather watcher was curious about the tiny cloud: ____________________.
cards.visibleCluePrompt: Visible clue: Add one nose-near pane, tiny cloud tag, tilted cup mark, or lifted paper shade: ____________________.
cards.objectActionPrompt: Object action: Let the cloud card drift, quiver, stick, or slide across the pretend pane: ____________________.
cards.placeSignalPrompt: Place signal: Add one Teacup Town sill, weather strip, or small forecast card near the window: ____________________.
cards.characterGesturePrompt: Character gesture: Show the watcher leaning close, raising eyebrows, or holding a finger just above the pane: ____________________.
cards.soundOrTexturePrompt: Sound or texture: Add one papery swish, smooth pane, misty edge, or soft cup clink detail: ____________________.
cards.sentenceFramePrompt: Sentence frame: Instead of saying curious, write how the watcher studies the moving cloud card: ____________________.
cards.reviseShowPrompt: Revise show: Make the plain line visible with one weather clue, one looking gesture, and one texture: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw the tiny cloud tag, then write what the watcher notices first: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Extra paper line: Show another Teacup Town feeling through a weather clue: ____________________.

cards.title: Pocket Park Index Card Notice Cheer
cards.showSkill: revise a told mood into board clues
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable index card for revising a plain pocket-park sentence into shown notice-board clues: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: Read the plain line and invite the writer to show the cheerful mood with board details: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: Show the notice keeper's cheerful mood through the paper board, posted note, and gesture: ____________________.
cards.plainLinePrompt: Plain line: The notice keeper felt cheerful about the new park sign: ____________________.
cards.visibleCluePrompt: Visible clue: Add one bright border, straightened corner, leaf stamp, or small drawn burst on the notice: ____________________.
cards.objectActionPrompt: Object action: Make the notice flutter, snap flat, slide into place, or lift on one corner: ____________________.
cards.placeSignalPrompt: Place signal: Add one pocket-park board edge, bench card, or paper path marker that keeps the scene grounded: ____________________.
cards.characterGesturePrompt: Character gesture: Show the keeper smoothing the notice, stepping back, or giving a small pleased nod: ____________________.
cards.soundOrTexturePrompt: Sound or texture: Add one crisp paper snap, bark-like board texture, smooth pin head, or leafy scratch detail: ____________________.
cards.sentenceFramePrompt: Sentence frame: Instead of saying cheerful, write what the keeper does after the notice sits straight: ____________________.
cards.reviseShowPrompt: Revise show: Trade the told mood for one notice-board clue, one object motion, and one gesture: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw the notice corner first, then write the shown mood sentence: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Extra paper line: Show another pocket-park mood with a board clue and a gesture: ____________________.
